children: Overview
China HR services provider's interim revenue for six months to June 30 grew 13.1% yr/yr
Adjusted profit attributable to equity holders rose 41.7% yr/yr
Company saw stable growth across business lines, led by digital tech and cloud services
Outlook
Company highlights ongoing demand for digital technology and cloud services staffing
Company plans to expand human resources services for Chinese enterprises going global
Result Drivers
DIGITAL TECH AND CLOUD SERVICES - Co said revenue from digital technology and cloud services grew 24.8% yr/yr, driven by demand for IT talent and AI-related transformation
DIGITAL OPERATION AND CUSTOMER SERVICE - Revenue from digital operation and customer service rose 22.7% yr/yr, supported by offshore projects and cross-border e-commerce
GENERAL SERVICE OUTSOURCING - Revenue from general service outsourcing grew 6.7% yr/yr, but demand for flexible staffing in general positions declined among certain domestic clients
